environment.description: Deployed on AWS Nitro Enclave-backed CI infrastructure. Config uses key_backend=hsm with keys held in CloudHSM cluster (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). The PKCS#11 provider is configured with CKA_SENSITIVE=true and CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false on all HMAC key objects. The enclave attestation document is validated before any PKCS#11 session is established. The HSM's firmware implements HMAC-verify as a single C_Verify PKCS#11 call returning CKR_OK/CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID in constant time (per CloudHSM firmware specification v3.4+). However, the Python code path for backend=hsm uses compute_hmac() which calls key.sign() and then does hmac.compare_digest() in application code rather than using C_Verify directly. The Nitro Enclave's vsock interface adds ~2-5ms jitter per call due to proxy routing through the parent instance's vsock-proxy with rate limiting at 50 req/s. Instance type is c6i.xlarge with Intel Ice Lake microarchitecture running in dedicated tenancy.
